description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git commit message encoding handling, particularly focusing on internationalization (i18n) aspects such as character encodings (UTF-8, ISO8859-1, eucJP, ISO-2022-JP). It includes setup routines, encoding validation, and test cases for various encoding scenarios.

methods.name: compare_with
methods.description: Compares the output of 'git show' against expected content, with optional character encoding conversion via iconv.

methods.name: test_commit_autosquash_flags
methods.description: Tests git commit with autosquash flags across different encodings.

methods.name: test_commit_autosquash_multi_encoding
methods.description: Tests rebasing and autosquashing commits with different source and target encodings.
